library.description: Runtime-neutral plugin lifecycle, extension and pipeline host for Node.js, Bun, browsers and workers.

blocks.text: English
把插件安装、依赖、配置和资源释放交给一个运行时中立的宿主，让类库或应用在功能扩展后仍有明确的提交与退出边界。

items: 安装一半失败却留下可调用扩展，根因是逐个发布而没有整个批次的提交与回滚边界。
外部改了一层嵌套设置，插件行为就变了，根因是宿主还持有调用者的配置引用。
关闭宿主时重复释放或顺序颠倒，根因是插件与资源各自管理清理列表。
换一个插件发现顺序就启动失败，根因是按参数顺序安装，没有表达提供方依赖。
缺了必需服务还先打开连接，根因是依赖检查放在安装器内部才进行。
批次失败只撤销本次新资源。 逐个公开扩展容易留下半套功能，defineHost 把本批提交与回滚放在同一边界，原有插件继续可用。运行证明。
配置由宿主持有，外部修改不会悄悄生效。 浅拷贝仍共享嵌套对象，definePlugin 复制并递归冻结准入配置；后续变更走 config.update。运行证明。
资源按取得逆序释放，重复关闭复用同一 Promise。 多份手写清理表容易顺序错误或重复释放，安装期间用 onDispose 登记资源，再由宿主统一释放。运行证明。
插件顺序由声明的能力依赖决定。 按发现顺序安装会先运行消费者，Feature 引用让提供方先建，并把同一输出注入消费者。运行证明。
缺少必需能力时，安装器还没有开始。 在安装器里临时查服务会留下已取得资源，Feature 依赖预检先拒绝缺失 provider，再决定是否进入安装。运行证明。

blocks.text: 问候功能已经在线。这时上线一批新功能：缓存插件先建好了连接，翻译插件却安装失败。宿主撤销这一整批：缓存连接被释放，问候功能照常响应。
输出：

blocks.code:
缓存连接已释放
新功能安装失败：PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED
你好

blocks.text: `use()` 按传入顺序返回句柄，`greeting.extensions` 就是 install 返回的方法。每个安装、更新或卸载 hook 默认最多等 5000 毫秒，超时回滚；卸载时等待在途 pipeline 排空也默认最多 5000 毫秒。需要更长期限或不设期限时，在 `defineHost({ host: { execution } })` 中覆盖，见全部选项。
遇到批次失败，看保留原插件并回滚新资源；遇到插件顺序问题，看声明 Feature 依赖。
直接登记一个函数很容易，安装失败与退出时仍需一致的责任边界。以下只展示隐患，进行类型检查，不运行：

blocks.code:
const extensions = new Map<string, { greet(): string }>()
extensions.set('greeting', { greet: () => '你好' }) // 隐患：立即发布没有定义整批安装成功的提交点。
const cached = extensions.get('greeting') // 隐患：删掉登记也不会撤销已缓存的方法。
const resources: Array<() => void> = []
const dispose = () => resources.forEach((release) => release()) // 隐患：正序清理且每次调用都会再释放。
void cached
void dispose

blocks.text: Host 在安装成功后返回能力句柄，并把注册资源收敛到统一释放路径。只有少数固定扩展点时，可保留简单组合函数；需要动态装卸、依赖与失败回滚时再使用宿主。

rows: 创建统一生命周期所有者
定义可安装功能与资源
在插件之间复用同一能力
使用安装后的公开方法
变更配置而不直接修改快照
暂停可达性或真正回收

blocks.text: “Host”拥有安装与释放；“定义”只描述插件，不代表已安装；“注册”是一次具体安装；“句柄”按名称访问当前注册；“Feature”是声明了依赖的能力输出；“stage”是插件参与的数据处理步骤；“lease”记录仍使用某代插件的在途运行。关闭的逻辑结果与资源真正完成释放可能是两个时刻。

按取得逆序释放插件资源且只执行一次
不依赖参数顺序，先启动提供方
缺少提供方时在安装器执行前拒绝

blocks.text: 下面的完整场景只导入根入口，不需要框架或外部 I/O。运行时依赖 capability、lifecycle、middleware-pipeline 与 utils；直接使用其独立入口时，把相应包列为消费项目的直接依赖。

rows: 创建函数式或类式插件宿主
安装批次或显式激活 lazy 插件
使用已安装能力、读取与更新配置
回收某插件或关闭整个宿主

blocks.text: 用 `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()({ mode?, next?, order? })` 为每种载荷声明管道，再把映射放到 defineHost 顶层的 pipelines。owner 拿到 use/run，安装中的插件 core 只有 use/through 登记权；默认 sync、single、install 顺序。各管道共用既有 Host 修订、快照、排序和 lease 排空机制；不传配置时保留默认管道和旧泛型用法。
完整代码及显式泛型写法见按载荷类型声明多条管道，示例也展示卸载同时撤回两条管道的步骤。插件自有声明与 through 组合见高阶用法。

本包管理插件安装、Feature 依赖、配置、stage 归属与释放，不实现领域业务，也不重复实现管线执行算法。运行时依赖为 `@migaia/capability`、`@migaia/lifecycle`、`@migaia/middleware-pipeline`、`@migaia/utils`。管线运行和 stage 提升复用 middleware-pipeline；生命周期 scope、变更队列与清理复用 lifecycle。
只有根入口 `@migaia/plugin-host` 与稳定子入口 `@migaia/plugin-host/composition`。不要依赖内部文件。普通应用使用根入口的 Host、插件、Feature、句柄和错误工具；composition 是单一组合 owner 的窄协议，不是另一套应用 Host。

类 `PluginHost<TDomainCore, TValue, TInstalled, TPipelines>` 的首个类型参数 TDomainCore 必须提供；运行时 createPluginDomainCore 的默认实现返回空对象。末尾 TPipelines 轴默认 `Record<never, never>`；pipeline 值类型默认 `never`，安装类型清单默认 `readonly []`；defineHost 的领域类型参数另有默认值。`TInstalled` 参与安装约束和配置推导，运行期 `use()` 不改变 Host 变量的静态类型，而是按输入顺序返回精确句柄 tuple。插件合并、提取等仅类型 helper 以发布声明为准；`IPluginHostCoreFor<THost>` 从 Host 类型提取领域 core 与 pipeline 轴，类型元数据不会安装运行时能力。
扩展点少且不需要动态装卸时，普通选项或组合函数可能足够。只需执行 middleware 时可直接使用 middleware-pipeline；本包适合需要统一插件资源、依赖、配置和可达性的类库或应用。logger 是仓库内采用此宿主的实际消费者。

blocks.text: `surface` 支持对象或工厂。对象形式的自有描述符在获取 Runtime 之前读取一次，访问器保持动态，所有 canonical Host 键（包括 identity、use、unUse）仍为保留键。工厂形式 `surface: (native) => ({ ... })` 在创建最终 handle 时执行一次，收到冻结的原生 `use`、`unUse`，可组合并替换这两个方法；其他 canonical Host 键仍不能替换。领域方法、Host 身份、共享出口和 fluent 管线方法属于同一个冻结 handle，组合方应通过 surface 提供方法，不能复制返回的 handle。surface 读取或工厂失败保持原错，经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界分类。旧对象写法和三类型参数调用仍有效。

blocks.text: `use(...plugins)` 接收插件批次，按依赖拓扑安装，按原输入顺序返回句柄。`useSync` 不支持即时异步安装：install 的 Promise/thenable 导致 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`，cause 为 `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`，后续拒绝仍被观察；即时安装声明 setup 时在任何 hook 前抛顶层 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。构造选项没有 `plugins` 字段；类 owner 在构造期调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，函数 handle 使用 `useSync(...plugins)`。惰性定义可先同步登记，之后异步 activate。

句柄有 `name`、只读 `extensions`、`getFeature(name)` 与 `config.get()/update(recipe)`。句柄按名称找到当前注册，替换后可读到新实现；卸载后访问抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`。已经取出的 extension 函数绑定原注册，撤销后抛 `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。`isPluginHandleCurrent(handle)` 检查创建句柄时的那一代是否仍为当前注册；禁用或挂起仍为 true，替换、移除、dispose 或未知对象为 false。名称句柄替换后仍可读取新实现，这个精确代探测不改变该行为。

extension 必须是普通对象。仅可枚举且 configurable 的 data property 发布；访问器和不可配置属性以 `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝，非枚举键被忽略并报告 `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`。不要直接返回冻结对象。Host 协议键、`then`、清理 symbols 是保留键；`catch` 与 `finally` 可用。已有普通扩展冲突为 `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`，Host 保留键优先为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`，Object.prototype 成员冲突为 `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`。安装路径再用 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` 保留 cause；install 结果自带 then 的专门分类为 `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`。

sections.heading: 插件 core、setup 与资源归属

blocks.text: 安装与更新 core 包含领域能力，以及 `config.get()`、`operation`、`lifecycle`、`features`、`featureExpose`、`onDispose(resource)` 、`pipeline(name)` 和四个 `use*Pipeline(stage)`。config 返回已提交的递归只读快照；operation 提供当前操作 `signal` 与绝对 `deadlineAt`，lifecycle 提供注册代际的 signal。四个 use*Pipeline 方法仍返回 core；命名管道的 use/through 返回带幂等 remove() 的登记句柄。登记只允许安装窗口使用，且受模式兼容约束。
`core.onDispose` 只在安装窗口接管资源；窗口外抛 `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`，不会接管或释放新传入的资源，调用方仍负责它。资源可为清理函数、同步 disposable 或异步 disposable，PromiseLike 结果由生命周期 owner 同化。同步安装也能登记异步 disposer。

对象形 setup 的执行顺序是：创建领域 core → setup → featureExpose → 同步 Feature 工厂 → install。同一批次按依赖顺序串行。setup 仅得到 `config.get()`、`operation.{signal,deadlineAt,now()}`、`lifecycle.signal`、`onDispose(resource)`，没有 Feature 输出、pipeline 或 Host mutation 能力。setup 输出不克隆，原样作为 featureExpose 与 install 的第二参数；未声明 setup 时这两个 hook 仍只有一个 core 参数。

setup 与后续 install 共用本注册的 mutation 绝对期限；无期限时 deadlineAt 为 undefined，now 使用注入 scheduler 时钟。成功只关闭 setup 登记窗口，不中止 operation signal。期限到达或 Host 关闭时取消尝试并回滚已登记资源；永不兑现的 setup 不阻止关闭。迟到兑现不再安装，迟到拒绝经诊断报告；协作取消若回显同一 abort reason 不重复报告。

关闭后的 setup `context.onDispose` 会先尝试释放有效资源，再抛 `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`；无有效 disposer 则为 `INVALID_OPTION`。这与 core 的窗口外资源责任不同。异步 use、replace 候选及组合预备的 setup 失败用 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` 保留原 cause；lazy activate 保留原失败身份。恢复失败诊断只解开一层 PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED 包装，不剥离其他原错误的 cause。

`defineFeature(factory, dependencies?)` 或 `defineFeature({ install, dependencies? })` 创建同步的 opaque 定义，依赖默认空表。factory 的 `core.featureExpose` 是本插件显式提供的能力，第二参数只含声明的直接依赖别名。工厂不能返回 PromiseLike，但返回对象的方法可以异步。定义与引用靠本包身份存储验证，类型上的 `__feature` 不是真实运行时授权字段。

`definition.getFeature(name)` 只接受已声明的名称，默认是必需引用；`getFeature(name, { optional: true })` 声明可选引用，provider 缺席或尚未激活时输出可为 undefined；provider 已禁用仍抛 PREREQUISITE_DISABLED。`handle.getFeature(name)` 返回本次实例输出。引用保留 provider 名字字面量，`IPluginFeatureName`、`IPluginFeatureOutput` 可提取名称与输出。

Host 在任何 install 前检查必需 provider 和环，按依赖拓扑安装，不依赖 use 的输入顺序；消费者得到 provider 输出的原对象身份，实例输出按注册冻结。缓存的普通输出对象或纯函数不会自动附加撤销守卫；活性检查发生在 handle 读取、extension callable 和受保护的 featureExpose 入口。Feature 的本地依赖闭包也计入跨插件关系。缺失、禁用、移除分别为 `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`，环为 `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`，这些前置条件码直接在顶层，不包安装失败。

`readPluginDependencies(input)` 返回只读 `{ provider, required }` 列表，遍历本地完整闭包，按首次 provider 引用排序，同一 provider 必需优先。它接收定义、有效原始描述符或 composition admission；admission 复用已捕获快照，不重读 getter，其他输入经标准准入捕获一次。它不执行 setup、install 或工厂，准入失败的原生类型、错误对象和 stack 原样保留。

`host.config` 重复访问保持同一 facade。get 的 path 必填，可为插件名、`插件名.键` 或 `插件名.[下标].键`，支持继续深入；不存在的插件或路径返回 undefined。`config.update(name, recipe)` 的名称与 recipe 必填；recipe 同步返回 partial plain record，插件不存在时以 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED` 拒绝。handle.config 在插件范围内提供同样的 get 与 update。

初始配置被复制并递归冻结；普通对象、数组及受支持的原始值可用，函数值保留身份，因此不是 JSON 序列化契约。Date、RegExp、Map、Set、类实例、访问器、非枚举嵌套属性、symbol 键和值、危险键 `__proto__/constructor/prototype`、可调用 then 以及循环被拒绝。无环共享引用不等于循环。非法值为 `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`，循环为 `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`，detail 带 path 和 reason。修改冻结快照遵循 JS 原生行为，不Promise本包错误码。

update 对 patch 执行 Copy-on-Write：新分支复制并冻结，未改分支复用旧快照。插件 update(next, core) 读取候选完整 next，而 core.config.get() 仍是旧的已提交配置；成功才提交。recipe、patch 准入、update hook 或期限失败都不提交，不改变既有配置、revision 与已发布扩展。未分类回调失败经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界，保留原错或 cause；合法 PromiseLike 生命周期结果只同化一次。
get 与 update 都要求 active Host。通常 get 的入口失败同步抛出，update 在内部队列任务失败时 reject；setup/beforeRelease 窗口的同步禁止规则另见下节。

sections.id: 禁用-依赖策略-替换与惰性激活
sections.heading: 禁用、依赖策略、替换与惰性激活

blocks.text: `await host.plugin.disable(name)` 返回 `{ token }`；`await token.enable()` 精确恢复原注册，`host.plugin.enable(name)` 按名启用，`disabled()` 返回当前名称只读快照。禁用保留资源与 scope，不调用 disposer；extension、Feature 和 stage 暂不可达，配置仍可读取和更新。安装成功先通知一次 onEnable，之后每次真实状态切换通知对应 hook；通知失败仅诊断，不回滚状态。provider 仍禁用时不能单独启用依赖者，token 先检查整组，失败不部分启用。

disable 与 unUse 的选项是 `{ policy?: 'reject' | 'cascade' | 'suspend'; dryRun?: boolean }`，默认 policy 为 reject、dryRun 为 false。reject 保留状态并用 DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED 的 detail.blockedBy 列出全部传递依赖者；cascade 连同必需依赖闭包处理；suspend 只处理目标，保留已激活依赖者的实例与资源。挂起时句柄及取出的 extension 抛 `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`，stage 不运行。同一 provider 重新启用可直接恢复；同名新 provider 按 capability 的 resume 计划换绑、重启或恢复。整图释放仍按依赖者优先处理挂起注册。

`dryRun: true` 返回冻结计划 `{ policy, order, steps, edges }`，不含 ok，不执行变更。真实 unUse 的成功与失败分支均带冻结 `affected`，只含已生效步骤；失败还返回 errors。迁移：严格比较旧 `{ ok: true }` 的调用方应改为检查 ok 并读取 affected；宽 boolean 先按值分支，字面量 dryRun true 选择计划重载，省略或 false 选择执行重载。旧 `{ cascade: true }` 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。

replace(name, next) 要求同名，先安装候选，失败时旧实现继续服务。提交后新运行只含新代 stage，旧运行保留旧代租约，旧 extension 立即撤销，名称句柄指向新代；原禁用状态保留。已激活必需依赖者可用 onDependencyReplaced 换绑；缺钩子或钩子失败则连同必需闭包按依赖者优先排空释放，再按拓扑重装，保留运行时配置、原激活与禁用状态。旧代排空后释放。重装失败不撤回新 provider，失败依赖者保持卸载，抛 DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED，cause 为 AggregateError，顺序为重装失败、换绑错误、清理错误，detail.dependents 列出影响。清理次错经诊断保留。

lazy 插件 use 时只登记；扩展访问抛 PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED。activate(name) 先激活必需惰性 provider，再安装自身；同名并发共享同一 Promise。非惰性安装也会先激活所需惰性 provider；只被惰性成员引用的惰性项不提前安装，依赖校验失败不激活。禁用项 activate 抛 PLUGIN_DISABLED。失败撤销尝试的 stage、extension 和共享 receipt，清理资源，保留 cold registration/handle；显式重试使用新 scope 与新 batch core。清理次错不覆盖主错，物理迟到工作继续被观察。

use、unUse、config.update 等变更共享 lifecycle 的 FIFO mutation 队列。默认排队超过 1000 ms 仅诊断且不带 code；显式 queueAdmissionTimeoutMs 数值才移出超时排队项并以 MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT 拒绝，已经运行的任务不受该准入计时器中断，后续 Host 仍可用。false 关闭计时器与诊断。dispose 以不受排队拒绝驱逐的终态任务进入队列。

生命周期 hook（含 setup、install、Feature/expose、update、beforeRelease、dispose、启停通知及换绑）禁止重入 Host mutation，失败为 `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`。use/unUse/replace/config.update 的入口守卫可同步抛错，异步 enablement 入口则以 Promise 拒绝。setup 或 beforeRelease 整个等待窗口内，新变更也按对应入口形式拒绝；窗口前已入队任务仍 FIFO 等待，可能受到已配置的准入超时。
同步 hook 内 activate 在查共享请求前拒绝；但运行时无异步上下文，hook await 之后的同名 activate 与外部调用一样可能共享本次 Promise。等待自己的激活会自等待：有限 mutationTimeoutMs 最终以 MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT 回滚，false 关闭期限时可能不结束。应在 hook 外发起激活。

sections.heading: 命名管道：类型、权限与生命周期

blocks.text: 在函数入口的顶层 `pipelines`，或类构造选项的 `pipelines`，声明一个固定的“名字 → `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)`”映射。每条管道独立推断载荷和 mode；名字是非空的自有可枚举字符串键，值必须来自真实 `pipelineSpec`，不能用结构相同的普通对象替代。说明对象被冻结；Host 的声明在构造时固定；插件也可在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 声明自己的组，随安装创建、失败回滚、卸载按原预算排空后删除。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道，冲突以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。

rows: `'sync'`、`'async'`、`'generator'`、`'async-generator'`；决定 stage 及 run 返回类型。
`'single'` 或 `'multiple'`；直接采用 middleware-pipeline 的四模式继续及失败规则。
`'install'` 按分配顺序，`'reverse'` 按其逆序；同一插件在所有管道共享原排序 slot。

blocks.text: 持有函数 handle 的 owner 调用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` 或 `.run(value, done)`；类 owner 使用 protected `pipeline(name)`。安装中的插件和 Feature core 只有 `use(stage)`、`through(name)` 登记权，没有 run。两种命名登记都返回带幂等 `remove()` 的句柄；移除影响后续运行，已取得的快照仍由原生命周期排空。

插件和它的 Feature 用原名访问 Host 管道、用短名访问自己的管道，并通过既有 Feature 依赖用 `插件名.管道名` 访问提供方的组。无依赖关系的插件不能访问别人的组。`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 适合仅使用 Host 声明的 core；声明插件自己的管道时，保留 install 参数的推导，避免 Host-only 注解遮掉自己的短名。未知或不可见名字同步抛 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`；诊断包含查询的插件或 Feature、请求名和可见的 Host、本插件、依赖插件范围。

sync、generator 的命名 run 返回 `TResult | undefined`；async、async-generator 返回 `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`。短路返回 undefined，每次到达末端的遍历各调用一次 done。multiple 不返回结果数组；需要每次结果时，在 done 中明确收集。multiple 模式下，stage 可以处理经 next 的 then/await 观察到的分支失败；未观察的失败仍由 runner 拒绝，多个原错按启动顺序保留在 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED` 中。generator 用 throw 把失败交回 yield；sync 遍历全部登记值后汇总错误。

所有管道在同一 Host 事务中提交；每条管道在同一可见 stage 修订内复用编译快照，reverse 也只在编译时处理。没有可见 stage 时直接调用终点，不取快照或 lease。有 stage 时，所有管道复用同一套登记、排序和 quiescence/lease owner。安装失败回滚、unUse、replace、禁用和挂起在一次提交中作用于该插件的全部管道；已有运行持有原快照和分管道的代际 lease，drain 等待这些实际运行，清理和排空预算仍由既有生命周期配置控制。任何管道执行期间，owner 向任一管道注册 stage 都会抛 `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`。

Host 未声明 pipelines 时，其命名轴默认为 `Record<never, never>`；已知插件定义仍能推出其限定名。Host 和插件都没有命名组时，不分配额外的命名 runner、lane 或 lease key。原 `TValue`、`pipeline.mode`、四个 use*Pipeline、runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync、pipelineMode 都只操作默认管道，原有显式泛型调用不变。默认管道使用内部 symbol，不占用任何字符串名字。显式填写 defineHost 泛型并同时声明命名管道时，要在第五个泛型参数传 `typeof pipelines`；省略它会保留空轴，pipeline(name) 只接受 never。

非法 map、名字、spec、order 以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 在构造时拒绝，不返回 handle；mode 非法仍是 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。next 非法的外层码为 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`，cause 保留 middleware-pipeline 的 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION`。spec 配置 getter 抛错时也以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 保留原 cause。
`core.pipeline('y').through('z')` 在 y 的这个位置进入 z，z 的终点就是 y 剩余的步骤和原终点。z 可以改写同一载荷、短路，也可以在 async stage 的 `await next(value)` 后处理余下链路的结果。目标自己的 order 仍然有效。

两条管道的载荷类型和 mode 必须相同。mode 不同以 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH` 拒绝；目标允许 multiple 而来源不允许，或登记产生环时，以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。环只在登记时检查。空目标直接调用来源的 next，不取目标快照或 lease。through 返回的登记句柄支持幂等 `remove()`，属于发起登记的插件，卸载时一起撤回。`use` 仍只接收 stage，不接收字符串或管道对象；Host owner 的入口仍是 use/run。
以下四个 use*Pipeline 方法在 Host 侧返回 this，在插件 core 上返回 core；命名 use/through 则返回登记句柄。兼容关系如下，不能提升时同步抛 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH，cause 保留上游 middleware-pipeline TypeError / INVALID_OPTION：

默认管道由 class owner 从领域入口调用 protected runPipeline(value, done)，函数 handle 直接调用；value 与 done 必填，done 接收终值。sync 的 next 只记录值，当前 stage 返回后才执行下游；async 首次 next 立即启动下游，await next 可写下游完成后的后置逻辑。不调用 next 是正常短路，done 不执行但调用可正常完成。默认 single 策略下重复 next 为 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，迟到 next 被忽略并诊断 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE。

默认 single 策略下，generator 与 async-generator 都先耗尽当前 stage，普通返回值交给下一步；隐式 undefined 或 GENERATOR_HALT 终止，GENERATOR_CONTINUE 采用最后 yield（零 yield 用输入），GENERATOR_UNDEFINED 才把业务 undefined 继续交付，类型必须允许它。async-generator 串行 await，不是流式 fan-out 或洋葱模式。模式、stage 类型与这三个唯一 symbol 从 middleware-pipeline 直接导入，消费项目应直接安装该包。
把这三个 symbol 作为 stage 返回值时，它们是控制信号，不是业务数据。
下面把输入 `migaia` 转成大写，再加上方括号。第一步返回 `GENERATOR_CONTINUE`，让最后一次 yield 的值进入第二步；第二步直接返回最终字符串。
输出 `[MIGAIA]`：第二个 stage 收到 `MIGAIA`，完成回调收到加上方括号后的结果。中间 yield 不会逐个触发下游。
执行中（含外层尚未结束的嵌套调用）注册新 stage 抛 PIPELINE_EXECUTING。每次运行捕获已准入 stage；slot 按首次分配顺序与 Host stage 排列，禁用、恢复、替换不重排。新运行不再取得已撤销代，旧运行用自己的 lease 完成或协作退出。

四种 stage 的最后参数都有 context（generator 是第二参数），context.signal 是 Host 生命周期信号。dispose 开始时 abort，外部 I/O 仍需 stage 自己消费 signal；runner 在进入、返回、next 等协作检查点以 HOST_DISPOSING 或 HOST_DISPOSED 中止，不Promise强行取消任意 Promise。signal.reason 与稍后准入错误可同码但不保证同一对象。普通业务失败优先于同时取消；单个普通失败保留原对象。async 的 stage 与下游双失败为 AggregateError / PIPELINE_FAILED，errors 固定 [stageError, downstreamError]；async-generator 串行路径无此双帧聚合，factory/body/done 的单失败原样传播。

已安装注册释放前最多运行一次 beforeRelease(context)；普通卸载的钩子期间，该代仍可服务已有调用。context.signal 属于注册生命周期，deadlineAt 与 remainingMs() 使用 Host 时钟和 disposeStepTimeoutMs；禁用、挂起和未激活 lazy 登记本身不触发此钩子。失败或超时收集为清理错误，卸载不回滚。定义迁移：旧非函数 beforeRelease 元数据现在以 TypeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。

之后撤销注册与 stage 的新准入，排空相关 lease，执行插件 disposer，再逆序释放所登记资源。普通 unUse/dispose 使用 disposeStepTimeoutMs 的步骤预算，超时以 DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT 结束等待并继续其余步骤，不会取消仍执行的 Promise。自定义 disposer 等待触发自身的 host.dispose 会形成自等待；有限步骤预算可让逻辑关闭继续，false 则无限等待。

unUse 返回 `{ ok: true, affected }` 或 `{ ok: false, errors, affected }`；排空到限记录 PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT，仍继续有界清理。默认内核 dispose 重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，返回 logicalTerminal、cleanupErrors、cleanupComplete 和可能的 physicalCompletion，不因清理错误重开 Host。defineHost 自定义 options.dispose 中间件可 throw/reject，此时该失败被分类并拒绝同一个记忆化 Promise；不能把内核的结果契约扩展为任意自定义回调绝不拒绝。

cleanupComplete false 不代表资源已释放。cleanupErrors 是当前快照，physicalCompletion 只提供之后新增的错误，可能继续带下一层 continuation；需要完整最终结果可使用 lifecycle 的 mergeCleanupResults([result])，直接导入时直接安装 lifecycle。有限预算不终止在途 lease 或 disposer，迟到错误仍被观察。
资源函数直接执行；资源对象优先选择异步 disposer，再同步 disposer。插件自有 dispose 优先，其次符号清理。asyncDisposeKey 在宿主有 Symbol.asyncDispose 时复用原生键，否则使用 fallback；同步资源使用原生 Symbol.dispose 或普通函数，不强制 polyfill。
`isManagedHost(value)` 探测本物理包实例构造的 Host；`openComposition(host)` 只接受这种身份，不接受伪造对象或另一份包副本的实例。身份登记 writer 不公开，defineHost 不接受 receiver 别名。

revision 是 Host 已提交修改的版本号，不是尝试操作的次数。composition owner 可读取 revision/getCurrentSnapshot()，通过 createPluginAdmission 捕获定义、createDataOrderSlot(name) 保留 opaque 排序槽，再 prepareAdmissions([{ admission, slot }])。setup 可在准备期执行，但 extension、config、Feature、stage 暂不公开。commitPreparedAdmissions 同步发布、不执行用户代码，revision 已变化则拒绝；discardPreparedAdmissions 对暂存资源只回滚一次。返回 registration token 精确指向那次安装，不按名称误删新代。

createDataOrderSlot 调用即保留顺序；禁用、恢复和 replace 沿用 slot。只有定义永久删除或 session 结束才 retireDataOrderSlot。prepareUnUseBatch 按 owner 的清理顺序接收 exact tokens；commitPreparedUnUseBatch(prepared, { beforeCleanup? }) 先逻辑撤销，再等待 fence 和该代 pipeline lease。beforeCleanup 可选，无默认 Promise，但提供时始终先完成。

托管清理使用 execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs（默认 5000）：数值是本批次 lease 与全部清理步骤共享的预算，耗尽继续后续步骤，即使普通 disposeStepTimeoutMs 为 false；显式 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs false 才逐项等待真实完成并绕过普通步骤预算。预算不撤销进行中的工作；确认物理释放前，应等待全部 physicalCompletion 延续完成，或由拥有 realm 的外层终止其实际执行环境。

`createView(token)` 返回只含该 exact registration 的 extensions 的窄 view，无 Host、config、shared 或 mutation 能力。相同 token 的函数引用稳定，receiver 为 concrete Host。token view 禁用期间仍有效，完整 Host view 此时拒绝；启用恢复原函数引用，卸载两者均撤销。foreign/撤销 token 失败关闭。迁移：旧根 createRegistrationView 与 IPluginRegistrationReceipt 已移除，使用 composition createView/IRegistrationToken。
`inspectFeatures(roots)` 从 composition 入口只读检查可信 Feature 拓扑，不运行工厂。

适配器的 `getPluginRuntimeIntegration(core)` 只接受 canonical 本包 core，负责已声明的共享出口、Feature 与注册生命周期对接；不是给普通插件绕过准入的 API。同 family 规范贡献才可共享槽，普通扩展或其他 family 不可占用。不可扩展 Host 新共享 getter 发布失败保持原生 TypeError / PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED，不残留失败 family，普通 handle 扩展仍遵守既有不可扩展 Host 契约。

PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `plugin.host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

rows: 宿主已终态，创建新 Host，不能复用。
宿主正在关闭，不能开始新变更。
同一名称已占用或在批次中重复。
目标名称不存在，或句柄已无对应安装。

必需 provider 不可用使插件挂起，先恢复依赖。
lazy 插件未激活，先 await activate。
请求了未声明的 Feature 名称。

必需 provider 已禁用，启用后重试。
必需 provider 已卸载，需要重新安装。

变更会遗留必需依赖者，detail.blockedBy 列出传递闭包。
替换候选名称不同，未安装候选。

install 结果自带 then，或同步路径得到异步结果，不发布此扩展。
beforeRelease 或插件释放步骤失败，cause 保留原错，其余清理继续。
扩展键已占用，Host 保留键优先分类为 EXTENSION_RESERVED。
扩展使用 Host 协议键、then 或清理 symbol。

core 在安装窗口外拒绝且不接管；setup 关闭后的有效资源先释放再拒绝。

sections.id: 同一列表的两个执行入口
sections.heading: 同一列表的两个执行入口

blocks.text: 同步/异步宿主的拥有者可在 `defineHost` 句柄调用 `runPipelineSync(value, terminal)` 或 `runPipelineAsync(value, terminal)`；子类使用同名 protected 入口。两者共用登记列表、顺序和生命周期租约，同步 stage 在两边执行。存在可见异步 stage 时，同步入口在任何 stage 或终点执行前抛 `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`；卸载或禁用该 stage 后恢复同步执行。

同步入口返回 `TResult | undefined`；异步入口接受返回 `Promise<TResult>` 的终点，返回 `Promise<TResult | undefined>`。stage 不调用 next 时以 undefined 停止。零 stage 直接调用终点，保留原值或 Promise 身份；非空异步管线等待真实终点结束再清理。生成器宿主继续使用 `runPipeline`，显式同步/异步入口以 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH` 拒绝该模式。

`getPluginRuntimeIntegration(core).assertPreparedRegistration()` 仅检查原注册：当前安装沿原 operation 准入；同一尚未发布批次已完成的候选沿原 batch 精确身份与当前安装检查；发布后沿原 handle 准入。回滚、移除或宿主关闭后拒绝，不返回注册对象，也不授予晚注册资源或安装权限。`assertCurrent()` 与 `core.config.get()` 的原有语义不变。

blocks.text: 先安装根入口包；每段都是独立完整场景，与网站同名案例的代码相同。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/plugin-host

blocks.text: 共同参数：defineHost 的 host 可选；嵌套 execution.mutationTimeoutMs 与 execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 分别限制变更执行与 pipeline 排空，默认各 5000 毫秒，示例显式写出相同值，false 表示无限等待。pipeline.mode 未传时为 sync。省略 domainCore 时为空对象；省略自定义 dispose 时使用内核结构化清理。
应用需要添加具名功能并在之后释放资源，消费者需要安装完成后可用的扩展，而不是尚未初始化完成的插件对象。
直接把插件方法挂到对象上，没有定义何时提交安装、谁负责清理；异步安装尚未完成就返回，还会在资源就绪前暴露方法。
`defineHost` 创建生命周期所有者，等待 `host.use()` 后取得已安装登记；两个执行预算本例各设为 `5000` 毫秒，与默认值相同，使用结束后销毁宿主。
本例 `definePlugin` 的 `name` 为必填非空名称 `greeting`，`install` 必填并返回普通扩展对象；`greet` 是插件自定方法，无运行时参数，返回字符串。`host.use` 接收插件批次，返回句柄顺序与输入一致。
输出：

blocks.code: 你好

blocks.text: 输出 `你好`，登记扩展只在安装 `Promise` 完成后调用，最后一次等待用于等待宿主清理。
宿主句柄拥有宿主操作，插件拥有自己安装的扩展；`mutationTimeoutMs` 限制活动变更，`pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 限制关闭排空，显式 `false` 去掉对应截止时间，这些限制不会抢占用户 JavaScript。

sections.id: 批次失败时回滚新资源并保留原有插件
sections.heading: 批次失败时回滚新资源并保留原有插件

blocks.text: 一组功能安装多个插件，其中一个安装器拒绝配置；此前已安装的功能必须继续可用，本次失败批次里已经创建的资源则必须释放。
每装好一个扩展就立即发布，会在失败后留下半套可见功能；捕获失败后清空整个登记表，又会删除本批次之前已经提交的插件。
`defineHost` 在提交前保留 `use()` 批次的私有状态，在安装期间用 `core.onDispose` 登记草稿资源，再等待 `use(draft, broken)`，观察完成的回滚及原始失败原因。
`use(draft, broken)` 的两个参数为本批插件，既有 `existing` 不属于回滚范围。`core.onDispose(resource)` 的清理函数必填，安装期接管；`original` 是本地预建失败对象，`error.cause === original` 验证原身份。
输出：

blocks.code:
PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED true
草稿
运行中

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED true`、`草稿`、`运行中`；包装在 `cause` 保留原始 `TypeError`，失败批次释放草稿资源，原有登记仍可调用。
异步 `use()` 释放失败批次已登记的资源后才拒绝，本例取得一项资源，此前已提交登记继续可用；任意外部副作用不会自动撤销，回滚错误保留在次要详情中。

sections.id: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改
sections.heading: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改

blocks.text: 插件定义捕获应用设置后，调用者在安装前修改了原设置对象；安装后的配置应反映定义时的快照，而不是后来的外部修改。
浅拷贝只分离最外层对象，嵌套设置仍为共享引用，修改内层限制会悄悄改变后续安装器读到的内容。
`definePlugin` 在创建定义时对接纳的配置数据做快照并递归冻结，传入普通数据记录或数组，宿主随后通过 `config.get(path)` 读取自己的配置。
`config` 可选、默认空配置，本例字段为 `settings.limit: 3`；定义时捕获嵌套对象。`host.config.get(path)` 的必填路径 `meter.settings.limit` 依次选择插件、设置记录和限制值，未知路径返回 undefined。
输出：

blocks.code:
3
true true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `3`、`true true`；把外部 `settings.limit` 改为 `99` 没有改变安装值，捕获配置的两层对象也均已冻结。
省略 `config` 时使用空配置，这不是 JSON 序列化：支持的函数叶值保留身份，不支持的原型、访问器、符号、类 `Promise` 对象（带可调用 `then` 的对象）与环会被拒绝，已提交配置应通过 `host.config.update()` 修改。

sections.id: 按取得逆序释放插件资源且只执行一次
sections.heading: 按取得逆序释放插件资源且只执行一次

blocks.text: 插件按顺序取得资源，需要先释放后取得的资源；多个调用方还可能同时请求关闭宿主，清理不能为每个调用方重复执行。
各自保存清理列表，容易把其中一张表的顺序反过来，或把同一个释放器调用两次；每次关闭请求都启动清理，还会重复释放同一资源。
在 `definePlugin` 的安装期间，`core.onDispose` 把资源交给该登记，`defineHost` 复用同一个销毁 `Promise`，等待它即可观察插件钩子及资源栈的释放。
`core.onDispose` 分别接收两个无参清理函数，`dispose` 是对象定义的可选插件清理 hook；没有 hook 时不执行该步。宿主 `dispose()` 无参数，默认内核共享其清理 Promise，资源按登记逆序释放。
输出：

blocks.code:
true
插件,后取得,先取得
3

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true`、`插件,后取得,先取得`、`3`；并发销毁调用复用同一个销毁 `Promise`，插件钩子先于其资源执行，再次销毁没有新增释放。
`onDispose` 在安装期间接纳资源，不是任意时刻登记清理的接口；宿主收集清理失败，`disposeStepTimeoutMs` 默认每步 `5000` 毫秒，超过预算时应检查 `cleanupComplete` 与 `physicalCompletion`。

sections.id: 不依赖参数顺序-先启动提供方
sections.heading: 不依赖参数顺序，先启动提供方

blocks.text: 界面发现插件的顺序可能让消费方排在所需提供方之前，但消费方仍需要提供方的同一份输出，而不是重新构造的另一服务。
严格按数组顺序安装，会随发现顺序变化而失败；每个消费方内部重建依赖虽然避开缺值，却产生重复服务状态与不同生命周期。
`defineFeature` 声明同步工厂与依赖别名，`provider.getFeature()` 创建跨插件的必需引用，`host.use()` 校验依赖图并先启动提供方，再解析消费方。
`defineFeature(factory, dependencies?)` 的同步工厂必填，依赖表可选、默认空表；`summary` 的 `cache` 别名指向 `provider.getFeature("cache")`，默认必需。`features` 是插件可选的命名 Feature 表；`use(consumer, provider)` 故意逆序输入。
输出：

blocks.code:
提供方 -> 消费方
true
consumer provider

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `提供方 -> 消费方`、`true`、`consumer provider`；工厂按依赖顺序执行，消费方收到同一输出对象，返回登记句柄仍保持输入顺序。
工厂必须同步返回对象，但其方法可以异步；输出按登记冻结，省略依赖时为空映射，必需引用要求提供方可用，此图安排功能依赖，不追踪响应式数据变化。

sections.id: 缺少提供方时在安装器执行前拒绝
sections.heading: 缺少提供方时在安装器执行前拒绝

blocks.text: 一次部署启用了消费插件，却漏掉其必需提供方；宿主应在消费方取得资源之前指出缺失的前置依赖。
安装器内部才查找服务，会在先前初始化已经执行之后才发现问题；继续传递 `undefined` 则把失败转移到无关的消费代码里。
`getFeature()` 返回的引用默认必需，`defineFeature` 保留该依赖，`host.use()` 在安装前检查它，通过计数安装器调用来展示这一接纳边界。
`getFeature("cache")` 的名称必填且必须已声明；未提供 `{ optional: true }`，因此引用必需。`use(consumer)` 不含 provider，预检直接拒绝；`installs` 只在消费方的 install 中增加。
输出：

blocks.code:
PREREQUISITE_MISSING
0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`0`，缺失提供方被预检直接拒绝，消费安装器没有执行。
仅当消费方明确处理缺席输出 `undefined` 时，才用 `getFeature(name, { optional: true })`；提供方存在时必需和可选引用都参与排序，本例有意使用默认的必需引用。

sections.id: 按载荷类型声明多条管道
sections.heading: 按载荷类型声明多条管道

blocks.text: 把数字校验和文本拆分放进不同管道，stage 参数和 next 的值会按名字推断。命名说明在 defineHost 顶层传入；插件只登记步骤，由持有 host handle 的 owner 发起执行。
输出 `2 HI,hi`，然后是 `1`。插件移除同时撤回两条管道上的步骤。`core.pipeline('text')` 没有 run，错误名字或把数字交给 text 的 next 都无法通过类型检查。owner 自行登记用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)`，不属于任何插件；执行期间不能登记。
已有代码显式给 defineHost 泛型时，命名轴要放在原四个轴之后。复用说明对象的类型即可：

blocks.code:
import { defineHost, pipelineSpec } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

const pipelines = { count: pipelineSpec<number>()({}) }
const host = defineHost<
  Record<never, never>,
  number,
  readonly [],
  Record<never, never>,
  typeof pipelines
>({
  host: { execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } },
  pipelines
})
host.pipeline('count').use((value, next) => next(value + 1))
await host.dispose()

blocks.text: 省略 pipelines 的旧泛型用法不需要新增轴。类入口则是 `PluginHost<TDomainCore, TValue, TInstalled, TPipelines>`，通过类构造选项传同一个映射，并从子类的领域方法调用 protected pipeline。

sections.id: 高阶-插件声明自己的管道
sections.heading: 高阶：插件声明自己的管道

blocks.text: 插件可以在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 里声明载荷、mode、next 和 order，不要求应用预先复制它的约定。Host 声明用原名访问，本插件的管道用短名，依赖插件的管道用 `插件名.管道名`。下面复用真实 Feature 依赖，既决定安装顺序，也推导提供方的限定名；不新增权限列表。

输出 `hello!`。安装器保留 core 的推导，所以自己的 `envelope` 和依赖方的 `transport.envelope` 都有正确载荷类型。拥有自己管道的插件应保留 core 推导，避免只含 Host 声明的注解遮掉短名；`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 仍适用于上方只使用 Host 声明的示例。Host 的已安装定义类型轴只提供类型，实际安装仍由 `await host.use(...)` 完成。
插件及其 Feature 共享该插件的可见范围。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道；无依赖关系的查询以 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN` 拒绝，诊断包含调用方、请求名和可见范围。插件组在安装事务里创建，失败回滚，卸载按原预算排空后删除。

sections.heading: 高阶：用 through 组合管道

blocks.text: 把 target 嵌入 source 后，target 的终点就是 source 的剩余步骤和原终点。它可以修改值或短路，也可以在 `await next(...)` 之后处理余下链路的结果。
这里 target 先把一乘二，source 的剩余步骤再加一，原终点乘十。target 的 next 和 owner 的 run 都得到 `30`。`remove()` 幂等，只撤回这次登记；插件卸载会自动撤回自己的链接和 stage。已在运行的快照继续按原生命周期排空。

两条管道须有相同载荷类型和 mode。mode 不同以 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH` 拒绝；target 是 multiple 而 source 不是，或登记产生环时，以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝，环只在登记时检查。空 target 直接调用 source 的 next，不取 target 快照或 lease。`use` 仍只接收 stage，不接收字符串或管道对象。through 属于插件和 Feature 的登记入口，Host owner 仍用 use/run；完整规则见下方契约细节。

本包管理插件安装、Feature 依赖、配置、stage 归属与释放，不实现领域业务，也不重复实现管线执行算法。运行时依赖为 `@migaia/capability`、`@migaia/lifecycle`、`@migaia/middleware-pipeline`、`@migaia/utils`。管线运行和 stage 提升复用 middleware-pipeline；生命周期 scope、变更队列与清理复用 lifecycle。
只有根入口 `@migaia/plugin-host` 与稳定子入口 `@migaia/plugin-host/composition`。不要依赖内部文件。普通应用使用根入口的 Host、插件、Feature、句柄和错误工具；composition 是单一组合 owner 的窄协议，不是另一套应用 Host。

类 `PluginHost<TDomainCore, TValue, TInstalled, TPipelines>` 的首个类型参数 TDomainCore 必须提供；运行时 createPluginDomainCore 的默认实现返回空对象。末尾 TPipelines 轴默认 `Record<never, never>`；pipeline 值类型默认 `never`，安装类型清单默认 `readonly []`；defineHost 的领域类型参数另有默认值。`TInstalled` 参与安装约束和配置推导，运行期 `use()` 不改变 Host 变量的静态类型，而是按输入顺序返回精确句柄 tuple。插件合并、提取等仅类型 helper 以发布声明为准；`IPluginHostCoreFor<THost>` 从 Host 类型提取领域 core 与 pipeline 轴，类型元数据不会安装运行时能力。
扩展点少且不需要动态装卸时，普通选项或组合函数可能足够。只需执行 middleware 时可直接使用 middleware-pipeline；本包适合需要统一插件资源、依赖、配置和可达性的类库或应用。logger 是仓库内采用此宿主的实际消费者。

sections.heading: 创建 Host 与全部选项

blocks.text: 类入口可重写 `createPluginDomainCore()`，每次安装创建一份领域 core。默认返回空对象。领域 core 必须是普通对象、可枚举 data property，不能覆盖 `config`、`onDispose`、`pipeline` 或四个 `use*Pipeline` core 保留成员；无效表面以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。
函数入口 `defineHost(options)` 返回冻结的 canonical handle。它提供与类入口相同的功能，并把类上的 protected `useSync`、`runPipeline` 暴露给持有 handle 的 owner。选项 `host` 可选，形状与类构造选项一致；其余字段如下：

rows: 可选；省略返回空对象。request 的 `pluginName`、从零开始的批内 `batchIndex`、`batch` 身份均由宿主提供

blocks.text: `surface` 支持对象或工厂。对象形式的自有描述符在获取 Runtime 之前读取一次，访问器保持动态，所有 canonical Host 键（包括 identity、use、unUse）仍为保留键。工厂形式 `surface: (native) => ({ ... })` 在创建最终 handle 时执行一次，收到冻结的原生 `use`、`unUse`，可组合并替换这两个方法；其他 canonical Host 键仍不能替换。领域方法、Host 身份、共享出口和 fluent 管线方法属于同一个冻结 handle，组合方应通过 surface 提供方法，不能复制返回的 handle。surface 读取或工厂失败保持原错，经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界分类。旧对象写法和三类型参数调用仍有效。
类构造 `options` 可选，defineHost 的 `host` 同样可选；全部省略时使用下表默认值：

blocks.text: 所有时间数值须有限、非负；非法选项、非函数回调或不满足 scheduler 协议的对象以 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。直接导入 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的消费项目需直接安装 utils。

`definePlugin(name, descriptorFactory, features?)` 只捕获定义。真正安装时同步创建一次 descriptor，再调用其 `install()`、`expose()`、`featureExpose()` hooks；后两者同步返回各自表面。需要配置、setup、更新和释放钩子时使用对象形 `definePlugin(definition)`。两种定义和有效原始描述符走相同准入路径，不在定义时执行安装或 Feature 工厂。名称必填、非空、不能包含 `.`，在 Host 内唯一。对象形定义捕获 own data 字段并冻结；退役的 `shared` 字段不会回退为旧共享行为，应迁移到 Feature，适配器共享出口仍由规范 owner 协议管理。

blocks.text: `use(...plugins)` 接收插件批次，按依赖拓扑安装，按原输入顺序返回句柄。`useSync` 不支持即时异步安装：install 的 Promise/thenable 导致 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`，cause 为 `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`，后续拒绝仍被观察；即时安装声明 setup 时在任何 hook 前抛顶层 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。构造选项没有 `plugins` 字段；类 owner 在构造期调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，函数 handle 使用 `useSync(...plugins)`。惰性定义可先同步登记，之后异步 activate。

句柄有 `name`、只读 `extensions`、`getFeature(name)` 与 `config.get()/update(recipe)`。句柄按名称找到当前注册，替换后可读到新实现；卸载后访问抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`。已经取出的 extension 函数绑定原注册，撤销后抛 `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。`isPluginHandleCurrent(handle)` 检查创建句柄时的那一代是否仍为当前注册；禁用或挂起仍为 true，替换、移除、dispose 或未知对象为 false。名称句柄替换后仍可读取新实现，这个精确代探测不改变该行为。

extension 必须是普通对象。仅可枚举且 configurable 的 data property 发布；访问器和不可配置属性以 `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝，非枚举键被忽略并报告 `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`。不要直接返回冻结对象。Host 协议键、`then`、清理 symbols 是保留键；`catch` 与 `finally` 可用。已有普通扩展冲突为 `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`，Host 保留键优先为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`，Object.prototype 成员冲突为 `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`。安装路径再用 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` 保留 cause；install 结果自带 then 的专门分类为 `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`。

sections.heading: 插件 core、setup 与资源归属

blocks.text: 安装与更新 core 包含领域能力，以及 `config.get()`、`operation`、`lifecycle`、`features`、`featureExpose`、`onDispose(resource)` 、`pipeline(name)` 和四个 `use*Pipeline(stage)`。config 返回已提交的递归只读快照；operation 提供当前操作 `signal` 与绝对 `deadlineAt`，lifecycle 提供注册代际的 signal。四个 use*Pipeline 方法仍返回 core；命名管道的 use/through 返回带幂等 remove() 的登记句柄。登记只允许安装窗口使用，且受模式兼容约束。
`core.onDispose` 只在安装窗口接管资源；窗口外抛 `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`，不会接管或释放新传入的资源，调用方仍负责它。资源可为清理函数、同步 disposable 或异步 disposable，PromiseLike 结果由生命周期 owner 同化。同步安装也能登记异步 disposer。

对象形 setup 的执行顺序是：创建领域 core → setup → featureExpose → 同步 Feature 工厂 → install。同一批次按依赖顺序串行。setup 仅得到 `config.get()`、`operation.{signal,deadlineAt,now()}`、`lifecycle.signal`、`onDispose(resource)`，没有 Feature 输出、pipeline 或 Host mutation 能力。setup 输出不克隆，原样作为 featureExpose 与 install 的第二参数；未声明 setup 时这两个 hook 仍只有一个 core 参数。

setup 与后续 install 共用本注册的 mutation 绝对期限；无期限时 deadlineAt 为 undefined，now 使用注入 scheduler 时钟。成功只关闭 setup 登记窗口，不中止 operation signal。期限到达或 Host 关闭时取消尝试并回滚已登记资源；永不兑现的 setup 不阻止关闭。迟到兑现不再安装，迟到拒绝经诊断报告；协作取消若回显同一 abort reason 不重复报告。

关闭后的 setup `context.onDispose` 会先尝试释放有效资源，再抛 `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`；无有效 disposer 则为 `INVALID_OPTION`。这与 core 的窗口外资源责任不同。异步 use、replace 候选及组合预备的 setup 失败用 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` 保留原 cause；lazy activate 保留原失败身份。恢复失败诊断只解开一层 PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED 包装，不剥离其他原错误的 cause。

`defineFeature(factory, dependencies?)` 或 `defineFeature({ install, dependencies? })` 创建同步的 opaque 定义，依赖默认空表。factory 的 `core.featureExpose` 是本插件显式提供的能力，第二参数只含声明的直接依赖别名。工厂不能返回 PromiseLike，但返回对象的方法可以异步。定义与引用靠本包身份存储验证，类型上的 `__feature` 不是真实运行时授权字段。

`definition.getFeature(name)` 只接受已声明的名称，默认是必需引用；`getFeature(name, { optional: true })` 声明可选引用，provider 缺席或尚未激活时输出可为 undefined；provider 已禁用仍抛 PREREQUISITE_DISABLED。`handle.getFeature(name)` 返回本次实例输出。引用保留 provider 名字字面量，`IPluginFeatureName`、`IPluginFeatureOutput` 可提取名称与输出。

Host 在任何 install 前检查必需 provider 和环，按依赖拓扑安装，不依赖 use 的输入顺序；消费者得到 provider 输出的原对象身份，实例输出按注册冻结。缓存的普通输出对象或纯函数不会自动附加撤销守卫；活性检查发生在 handle 读取、extension callable 和受保护的 featureExpose 入口。Feature 的本地依赖闭包也计入跨插件关系。缺失、禁用、移除分别为 `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`，环为 `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`，这些前置条件码直接在顶层，不包安装失败。

`readPluginDependencies(input)` 返回只读 `{ provider, required }` 列表，遍历本地完整闭包，按首次 provider 引用排序，同一 provider 必需优先。它接收定义、有效原始描述符或 composition admission；admission 复用已捕获快照，不重读 getter，其他输入经标准准入捕获一次。它不执行 setup、install 或工厂，准入失败的原生类型、错误对象和 stack 原样保留。

`host.config` 重复访问保持同一 facade。get 的 path 必填，可为插件名、`插件名.键` 或 `插件名.[下标].键`，支持继续深入；不存在的插件或路径返回 undefined。`config.update(name, recipe)` 的名称与 recipe 必填；recipe 同步返回 partial plain record，插件不存在时以 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED` 拒绝。handle.config 在插件范围内提供同样的 get 与 update。

初始配置被复制并递归冻结；普通对象、数组及受支持的原始值可用，函数值保留身份，因此不是 JSON 序列化契约。Date、RegExp、Map、Set、类实例、访问器、非枚举嵌套属性、symbol 键和值、危险键 `__proto__/constructor/prototype`、可调用 then 以及循环被拒绝。无环共享引用不等于循环。非法值为 `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`，循环为 `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`，detail 带 path 和 reason。修改冻结快照遵循 JS 原生行为，不Promise本包错误码。

update 对 patch 执行 Copy-on-Write：新分支复制并冻结，未改分支复用旧快照。插件 update(next, core) 读取候选完整 next，而 core.config.get() 仍是旧的已提交配置；成功才提交。recipe、patch 准入、update hook 或期限失败都不提交，不改变既有配置、revision 与已发布扩展。未分类回调失败经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界，保留原错或 cause；合法 PromiseLike 生命周期结果只同化一次。
get 与 update 都要求 active Host。通常 get 的入口失败同步抛出，update 在内部队列任务失败时 reject；setup/beforeRelease 窗口的同步禁止规则另见下节。

sections.id: 禁用-依赖策略-替换与惰性激活
sections.heading: 禁用、依赖策略、替换与惰性激活

blocks.text: `await host.plugin.disable(name)` 返回 `{ token }`；`await token.enable()` 精确恢复原注册，`host.plugin.enable(name)` 按名启用，`disabled()` 返回当前名称只读快照。禁用保留资源与 scope，不调用 disposer；extension、Feature 和 stage 暂不可达，配置仍可读取和更新。安装成功先通知一次 onEnable，之后每次真实状态切换通知对应 hook；通知失败仅诊断，不回滚状态。provider 仍禁用时不能单独启用依赖者，token 先检查整组，失败不部分启用。

disable 与 unUse 的选项是 `{ policy?: 'reject' | 'cascade' | 'suspend'; dryRun?: boolean }`，默认 policy 为 reject、dryRun 为 false。reject 保留状态并用 DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED 的 detail.blockedBy 列出全部传递依赖者；cascade 连同必需依赖闭包处理；suspend 只处理目标，保留已激活依赖者的实例与资源。挂起时句柄及取出的 extension 抛 `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`，stage 不运行。同一 provider 重新启用可直接恢复；同名新 provider 按 capability 的 resume 计划换绑、重启或恢复。整图释放仍按依赖者优先处理挂起注册。

`dryRun: true` 返回冻结计划 `{ policy, order, steps, edges }`，不含 ok，不执行变更。真实 unUse 的成功与失败分支均带冻结 `affected`，只含已生效步骤；失败还返回 errors。迁移：严格比较旧 `{ ok: true }` 的调用方应改为检查 ok 并读取 affected；宽 boolean 先按值分支，字面量 dryRun true 选择计划重载，省略或 false 选择执行重载。旧 `{ cascade: true }` 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。

replace(name, next) 要求同名，先安装候选，失败时旧实现继续服务。提交后新运行只含新代 stage，旧运行保留旧代租约，旧 extension 立即撤销，名称句柄指向新代；原禁用状态保留。已激活必需依赖者可用 onDependencyReplaced 换绑；缺钩子或钩子失败则连同必需闭包按依赖者优先排空释放，再按拓扑重装，保留运行时配置、原激活与禁用状态。旧代排空后释放。重装失败不撤回新 provider，失败依赖者保持卸载，抛 DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED，cause 为 AggregateError，顺序为重装失败、换绑错误、清理错误，detail.dependents 列出影响。清理次错经诊断保留。

lazy 插件 use 时只登记；扩展访问抛 PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED。activate(name) 先激活必需惰性 provider，再安装自身；同名并发共享同一 Promise。非惰性安装也会先激活所需惰性 provider；只被惰性成员引用的惰性项不提前安装，依赖校验失败不激活。禁用项 activate 抛 PLUGIN_DISABLED。失败撤销尝试的 stage、extension 和共享 receipt，清理资源，保留 cold registration/handle；显式重试使用新 scope 与新 batch core。清理次错不覆盖主错，物理迟到工作继续被观察。

use、unUse、config.update 等变更共享 lifecycle 的 FIFO mutation 队列。默认排队超过 1000 ms 仅诊断且不带 code；显式 queueAdmissionTimeoutMs 数值才移出超时排队项并以 MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT 拒绝，已经运行的任务不受该准入计时器中断，后续 Host 仍可用。false 关闭计时器与诊断。dispose 以不受排队拒绝驱逐的终态任务进入队列。

生命周期 hook（含 setup、install、Feature/expose、update、beforeRelease、dispose、启停通知及换绑）禁止重入 Host mutation，失败为 `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`。use/unUse/replace/config.update 的入口守卫可同步抛错，异步 enablement 入口则以 Promise 拒绝。setup 或 beforeRelease 整个等待窗口内，新变更也按对应入口形式拒绝；窗口前已入队任务仍 FIFO 等待，可能受到已配置的准入超时。
同步 hook 内 activate 在查共享请求前拒绝；但运行时无异步上下文，hook await 之后的同名 activate 与外部调用一样可能共享本次 Promise。等待自己的激活会自等待：有限 mutationTimeoutMs 最终以 MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT 回滚，false 关闭期限时可能不结束。应在 hook 外发起激活。

sections.id: 命名管道-类型-权限与生命周期
sections.heading: 命名管道：类型、权限与生命周期

blocks.text: 在函数入口的顶层 `pipelines`，或类构造选项的 `pipelines`，声明一个固定的“名字 → `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)`”映射。每条管道独立推断载荷和 mode；名字是非空的自有可枚举字符串键，值必须来自真实 `pipelineSpec`，不能用结构相同的普通对象替代。说明对象被冻结；Host 的声明在构造时固定；插件也可在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 声明自己的组，随安装创建、失败回滚、卸载按原预算排空后删除。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道，冲突以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。

rows: `'sync'`、`'async'`、`'generator'`、`'async-generator'`；决定 stage 及 run 返回类型。
`'single'` 或 `'multiple'`；直接采用 middleware-pipeline 的四模式继续及失败规则。
`'install'` 按分配顺序，`'reverse'` 按其逆序；同一插件在所有管道共享原排序 slot。

blocks.text: 持有函数 handle 的 owner 调用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` 或 `.run(value, done)`；类 owner 使用 protected `pipeline(name)`。安装中的插件和 Feature core 只有 `use(stage)`、`through(name)` 登记权，没有 run。两种命名登记都返回带幂等 `remove()` 的句柄；移除影响后续运行，已取得的快照仍由原生命周期排空。

插件和它的 Feature 用原名访问 Host 管道、用短名访问自己的管道，并通过既有 Feature 依赖用 `插件名.管道名` 访问提供方的组。无依赖关系的插件不能访问别人的组。`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 适合仅使用 Host 声明的 core；声明插件自己的管道时，保留 install 参数的推导，避免 Host-only 注解遮掉自己的短名。未知或不可见名字同步抛 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`；诊断包含查询的插件或 Feature、请求名和可见的 Host、本插件、依赖插件范围。

sync、generator 的命名 run 返回 `TResult | undefined`；async、async-generator 返回 `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`。短路返回 undefined，每次到达末端的遍历各调用一次 done。multiple 不返回结果数组；需要每次结果时，在 done 中明确收集。multiple 模式下，stage 可以处理经 next 的 then/await 观察到的分支失败；未观察的失败仍由 runner 拒绝，多个原错按启动顺序保留在 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED` 中。generator 用 throw 把失败交回 yield；sync 遍历全部登记值后汇总错误。

所有管道在同一 Host 事务中提交；每条管道在同一可见 stage 修订内复用编译快照，reverse 也只在编译时处理。没有可见 stage 时直接调用终点，不取快照或 lease。有 stage 时，所有管道复用同一套登记、排序和 quiescence/lease owner。安装失败回滚、unUse、replace、禁用和挂起在一次提交中作用于该插件的全部管道；已有运行持有原快照和分管道的代际 lease，drain 等待这些实际运行，清理和排空预算仍由既有生命周期配置控制。任何管道执行期间，owner 向任一管道注册 stage 都会抛 `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`。

Host 未声明 pipelines 时，其命名轴默认为 `Record<never, never>`；已知插件定义仍能推出其限定名。Host 和插件都没有命名组时，不分配额外的命名 runner、lane 或 lease key。原 `TValue`、`pipeline.mode`、四个 use*Pipeline、runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync、pipelineMode 都只操作默认管道，原有显式泛型调用不变。默认管道使用内部 symbol，不占用任何字符串名字。显式填写 defineHost 泛型并同时声明命名管道时，要在第五个泛型参数传 `typeof pipelines`；省略它会保留空轴，pipeline(name) 只接受 never。

非法 map、名字、spec、order 以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 在构造时拒绝，不返回 handle；mode 非法仍是 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。next 非法的外层码为 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`，cause 保留 middleware-pipeline 的 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION`。spec 配置 getter 抛错时也以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 保留原 cause。
`core.pipeline('y').through('z')` 在 y 的这个位置进入 z，z 的终点就是 y 剩余的步骤和原终点。z 可以改写同一载荷、短路，也可以在 async stage 的 `await next(value)` 后处理余下链路的结果。目标自己的 order 仍然有效。

两条管道的载荷类型和 mode 必须相同。mode 不同以 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH` 拒绝；目标允许 multiple 而来源不允许，或登记产生环时，以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。环只在登记时检查。空目标直接调用来源的 next，不取目标快照或 lease。through 返回的登记句柄支持幂等 `remove()`，属于发起登记的插件，卸载时一起撤回。`use` 仍只接收 stage，不接收字符串或管道对象；Host owner 的入口仍是 use/run。
以下四个 use*Pipeline 方法在 Host 侧返回 this，在插件 core 上返回 core；命名 use/through 则返回登记句柄。兼容关系如下，不能提升时同步抛 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH，cause 保留上游 middleware-pipeline TypeError / INVALID_OPTION：

默认管道由 class owner 从领域入口调用 protected runPipeline(value, done)，函数 handle 直接调用；value 与 done 必填，done 接收终值。sync 的 next 只记录值，当前 stage 返回后才执行下游；async 首次 next 立即启动下游，await next 可写下游完成后的后置逻辑。不调用 next 是正常短路，done 不执行但调用可正常完成。默认 single 策略下重复 next 为 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，迟到 next 被忽略并诊断 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE。

默认 single 策略下，generator 与 async-generator 都先耗尽当前 stage，普通返回值交给下一步；隐式 undefined 或 GENERATOR_HALT 终止，GENERATOR_CONTINUE 采用最后 yield（零 yield 用输入），GENERATOR_UNDEFINED 才把业务 undefined 继续交付，类型必须允许它。async-generator 串行 await，不是流式 fan-out 或洋葱模式。模式、stage 类型与这三个唯一 symbol 从 middleware-pipeline 直接导入，消费项目应直接安装该包。
执行中（含外层尚未结束的嵌套调用）注册新 stage 抛 PIPELINE_EXECUTING。每次运行捕获已准入 stage；slot 按首次分配顺序与 Host stage 排列，禁用、恢复、替换不重排。新运行不再取得已撤销代，旧运行用自己的 lease 完成或协作退出。

四种 stage 的最后参数都有 context（generator 是第二参数），context.signal 是 Host 生命周期信号。dispose 开始时 abort，外部 I/O 仍需 stage 自己消费 signal；runner 在进入、返回、next 等协作检查点以 HOST_DISPOSING 或 HOST_DISPOSED 中止，不Promise强行取消任意 Promise。signal.reason 与稍后准入错误可同码但不保证同一对象。普通业务失败优先于同时取消；单个普通失败保留原对象。async 的 stage 与下游双失败为 AggregateError / PIPELINE_FAILED，errors 固定 [stageError, downstreamError]；async-generator 串行路径无此双帧聚合，factory/body/done 的单失败原样传播。

已安装注册释放前最多运行一次 beforeRelease(context)；普通卸载的钩子期间，该代仍可服务已有调用。context.signal 属于注册生命周期，deadlineAt 与 remainingMs() 使用 Host 时钟和 disposeStepTimeoutMs；禁用、挂起和未激活 lazy 登记本身不触发此钩子。失败或超时收集为清理错误，卸载不回滚。定义迁移：旧非函数 beforeRelease 元数据现在以 TypeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。

之后撤销注册与 stage 的新准入，排空相关 lease，执行插件 disposer，再逆序释放所登记资源。普通 unUse/dispose 使用 disposeStepTimeoutMs 的步骤预算，超时以 DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT 结束等待并继续其余步骤，不会取消仍执行的 Promise。自定义 disposer 等待触发自身的 host.dispose 会形成自等待；有限步骤预算可让逻辑关闭继续，false 则无限等待。

unUse 返回 `{ ok: true, affected }` 或 `{ ok: false, errors, affected }`；排空到限记录 PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT，仍继续有界清理。默认内核 dispose 重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，返回 logicalTerminal、cleanupErrors、cleanupComplete 和可能的 physicalCompletion，不因清理错误重开 Host。defineHost 自定义 options.dispose 中间件可 throw/reject，此时该失败被分类并拒绝同一个记忆化 Promise；不能把内核的结果契约扩展为任意自定义回调绝不拒绝。

cleanupComplete false 不代表资源已释放。cleanupErrors 是当前快照，physicalCompletion 只提供之后新增的错误，可能继续带下一层 continuation；需要完整最终结果可使用 lifecycle 的 mergeCleanupResults([result])，直接导入时直接安装 lifecycle。有限预算不终止在途 lease 或 disposer，迟到错误仍被观察。
资源函数直接执行；资源对象优先选择异步 disposer，再同步 disposer。插件自有 dispose 优先，其次符号清理。asyncDisposeKey 在宿主有 Symbol.asyncDispose 时复用原生键，否则使用 fallback；同步资源使用原生 Symbol.dispose 或普通函数，不强制 polyfill。
`isManagedHost(value)` 探测本物理包实例构造的 Host；`openComposition(host)` 只接受这种身份，不接受伪造对象或另一份包副本的实例。身份登记 writer 不公开，defineHost 不接受 receiver 别名。

composition owner 可读取 revision/getCurrentSnapshot()，通过 createPluginAdmission 捕获定义、createDataOrderSlot(name) 保留 opaque 排序槽，再 prepareAdmissions([{ admission, slot }])。setup 可在准备期执行，但 extension、config、Feature、stage 暂不公开。commitPreparedAdmissions 同步发布、不执行用户代码，revision 已变化则拒绝；discardPreparedAdmissions 对暂存资源只回滚一次。返回 registration token 精确指向那次安装，不按名称误删新代。

createDataOrderSlot 调用即保留顺序；禁用、恢复和 replace 沿用 slot。只有定义永久删除或 session 结束才 retireDataOrderSlot。prepareUnUseBatch 按 owner 的清理顺序接收 exact tokens；commitPreparedUnUseBatch(prepared, { beforeCleanup? }) 先逻辑撤销，再等待 fence 和该代 pipeline lease。beforeCleanup 可选，无默认 Promise，但提供时始终先完成。

托管清理使用 execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs（默认 5000）：数值是本批次 lease 与全部清理步骤共享的预算，耗尽继续后续步骤，即使普通 disposeStepTimeoutMs 为 false；显式 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs false 才逐项等待真实完成并绕过普通步骤预算。预算不撤销进行中的工作；要真实释放，应观察全部 physicalCompletion，或由拥有 realm 的外层终止其实际执行环境。

`createView(token)` 返回只含该 exact registration 的 extensions 的窄 view，无 Host、config、shared 或 mutation 能力。相同 token 的函数引用稳定，receiver 为 concrete Host。token view 禁用期间仍有效，完整 Host view 此时拒绝；启用恢复原函数引用，卸载两者均撤销。foreign/撤销 token 失败关闭。迁移：旧根 createRegistrationView 与 IPluginRegistrationReceipt 已移除，使用 composition createView/IRegistrationToken。
`inspectFeatures(roots)` 从 composition 入口只读检查可信 Feature 拓扑，不运行工厂。

适配器的 `getPluginRuntimeIntegration(core)` 只接受 canonical 本包 core，负责已声明的共享出口、Feature 与注册生命周期对接；不是给普通插件绕过准入的 API。同 family 规范贡献才可共享槽，普通扩展或其他 family 不可占用。不可扩展 Host 新共享 getter 发布失败保持原生 TypeError / PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED，不残留失败 family，普通 handle 扩展仍遵守既有不可扩展 Host 契约。

PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `plugin.host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

简体中文
Give a runtime-neutral Host ownership of plugin installation, dependencies, configuration, and cleanup, so an extensible library or application keeps clear commit and shutdown boundaries.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A failed installation leaves callable extensions because each plugin publishes without a batch commit and rollback boundary.
An external nested-setting edit changes plugin behavior because the Host still references caller-owned configuration.
Closing repeats cleanup or releases resources in the wrong order because plugins and resources maintain separate teardown lists.
Changing discovery order breaks startup because input order replaces declared provider dependencies.
A missing service is discovered after connections open because dependency checks happen inside installers.

A failed batch releases only its new resources. Publishing extensions one at a time can expose a partial bundle, so defineHost commits or rolls back the batch while earlier plugins keep serving. Runnable proof.

The Host owns its captured configuration. A shallow copy still aliases nested objects; definePlugin copies and recursively freezes admitted config, with later committed changes through config.update. Runnable proof.

Release resources in reverse order and share one closing promise. Separate cleanup lists invite ordering mistakes or duplicate release; onDispose registers resources during installation for one cleanup path owned by the host. Runnable proof.

Declared capability dependencies determine installation order. Discovery order can place a consumer first; Feature references start its provider first and inject the exact output object. Runnable proof.

Missing requirements fail before installers start. Looking up services during installation can fail after resource acquisition; Feature preflight rejects missing providers before entering installers. Runnable proof.

blocks.text: `use()` returns handles in input order, and `greeting.extensions` holds the methods that install returned. Each install, update or removal hook waits at most 5000 ms by default and rolls back on expiry; removal also waits at most 5000 ms by default for in-flight pipeline runs to drain. To allow longer or unbounded waits, override them in `defineHost({ host: { execution } })`; see all options.
For failed batches, see rollback without removing existing plugins. For ordering, see declared Feature dependencies.
Registering a function is easy; failed installation and shutdown still need consistent ownership. This illustration is type-checked only and is not run:

const extensions = new Map<string, { greet(): string }>()
extensions.set('greeting', { greet: () => 'hello' }) // Pitfall: immediate publication has no successful-batch commit point.
const cached = extensions.get('greeting') // Pitfall: deleting the entry does not revoke cached methods.
const resources: Array<() => void> = []
const dispose = () => resources.forEach((release) => release()) // Pitfall: cleanup runs forward and repeats on every call.
void cached
void dispose

Declarations share the existing Host revision, snapshots, ordering, and lease drain; omitting them preserves the default pipeline and existing generic calls.
See the complete typed example, including explicit generic calls and removal across both pipelines. Plugin-owned declarations and through composition are covered in the advanced guide.

This module owns plugin installation, Feature dependencies, configuration, stage ownership, and cleanup. Applications supply domain behavior. It depends on `@migaia/capability`, `@migaia/lifecycle`, `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`, and `@migaia/utils`. Pipeline execution and stage lifting use middleware-pipeline; lifecycle scopes, mutation queues, and cleanup use lifecycle.

The public entries are `@migaia/plugin-host` and `@migaia/plugin-host/composition`. Do not import internal files. Applications normally use the root Host, plugin, Feature, handle, and error APIs. Composition is a narrow protocol for one composition owner rather than an alternative application Host.

The class `PluginHost<TDomainCore, TValue, TInstalled, TPipelines>` requires its first type parameter, TDomainCore. Its runtime createPluginDomainCore implementation returns an empty object by default. The final TPipelines axis defaults to `Record<never, never>`. The pipeline value type defaults to `never` and the declared installed tuple to `readonly []`; defineHost separately provides a default domain type. TInstalled informs installation constraints and configuration types. Runtime use() returns an exact input-order handle tuple; it does not change the static type of the Host variable. Published declarations cover the type-only extraction and merging helpers. `IPluginHostCoreFor<THost>` extracts a Host's domain and pipeline axes; type metadata adds no runtime capability.

Simple options or composed functions can suffice for a few static extension points. Use middleware-pipeline directly when only middleware execution is needed. This Host is useful when a library or application needs consistent plugin resources, dependencies, configuration, and reachability. Logger is an existing repository consumer.

blocks.text: The class entry can override `createPluginDomainCore()` to create a domain core for each installation. The default is an empty object. Domain cores must be ordinary objects with enumerable data properties. They cannot override config, onDispose, or the four use*Pipeline core members. Invalid surfaces retain native TypeError with INVALID_OPTION.

`defineHost(options)` returns one frozen canonical handle. It supports the class behavior and exposes the class-protected useSync and runPipeline methods to the owner holding that handle. Its optional `host` field has the same shape as the class constructor options.

blocks.text: `surface` accepts an object or a factory. Object-form own descriptors are captured once before Runtime acquisition; accessors remain live, and all canonical Host keys, including identity, use, and unUse, remain reserved. The factory form `surface: (native) => ({ ... })` runs once while creating the final handle. It receives the frozen native `use` and `unUse` operations and may compose and replace those two methods; other canonical Host keys remain reserved. Domain members, Host identity, shared outlets, and fluent pipeline methods belong to the same frozen handle. Composing module should provide methods through surface rather than copy the returned handle. Surface-read or factory failures retain the original through CALLBACK_FAILED. Existing object forms and calls with three type parameters remain valid.
Class constructor options are optional, and so is defineHost's host field; omitted fields use the defaults below.

`definePlugin(name, descriptorFactory, features?)` captures a definition without installing it. Each installation synchronously creates one descriptor, then uses its install(), expose(), and featureExpose() hooks. The two expose hooks return synchronous surfaces. Use `definePlugin(definition)` for configuration, setup, update, and disposal hooks. Both forms and valid raw descriptors share admission. Defining them does not execute an installer or Feature factory. Names are required, nonempty, unique within a Host, and cannot contain a dot. blocks.text: use(...plugins) accepts a plugin batch. Installation follows dependency order; returned handles follow input order. useSync cannot perform immediate asynchronous installation: a Promise/thenable result causes PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause, while its eventual rejection stays observed. Immediate installation with setup throws top-level SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL before any hook. Constructor options have no plugins field. A class owner calls protected useSync(plugins); the functional handle takes useSync(...plugins). Lazy definitions can be registered synchronously and activated later.

A handle has name, readonly extensions, getFeature(name), and config.get()/update(recipe). Member reads resolve the current registration by name, so an old handle can read a replacement implementation. After removal it throws PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED. An extracted extension function remains bound to its original registration and throws REGISTRATION_REVOKED after revocation. `isPluginHandleCurrent(handle)` instead checks the generation present when that handle was created: disabled and suspended remain current, while replacement, removal, disposal, and unknown objects return false. This probe does not change name-addressed member reads.

Extension results must be ordinary objects. Only enumerable, configurable data properties are published. Accessors and nonconfigurable properties fail with INVALID_OPTION; non-enumerable keys are intentionally skipped with EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED. Do not return a frozen extension object. Host keys, then, and disposal symbols are reserved; catch and finally are allowed. Occupied ordinary keys produce EXTENSION_DUPLICATE; canonical keys take EXTENSION_RESERVED precedence; Object.prototype conflicts produce EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE. Installation retains these failures under PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED. An own then key has its specific INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE classification.

Install/update cores include the domain core plus config.get(), operation, lifecycle, features, featureExpose, onDispose(resource), pipeline(name), and four use*Pipeline(stage) methods. Config reads the committed recursively readonly snapshot. Operation supplies its signal and absolute deadlineAt; lifecycle supplies the registration-generation signal. The four use*Pipeline methods still return the core; named use/through return registration handles with idempotent remove(). Registration is install-window-only and enforces mode compatibility.

core.onDispose takes ownership only during installation. Outside that window it throws RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL without acquiring or releasing the supplied resource; the caller still owns it. Resources may be cleanup functions, synchronous disposables, or asynchronous disposables. Their PromiseLike results are assimilated by the lifecycle owner. Synchronous installation may register asynchronous disposers.

Object-form setup runs in this order: domain core → setup → featureExpose → synchronous Feature factories → install. A batch proceeds serially in dependency order. Setup receives only config.get(), operation.{signal,deadlineAt,now()}, lifecycle.signal, and onDispose(resource). It has no Feature outputs, pipeline registration, or Host mutation capability. Its output is passed by identity as the second argument to featureExpose and install. Without setup, those hooks retain their one-core-argument calls.

Setup and subsequent install share the registration's absolute mutation deadline. With no deadline, deadlineAt is undefined; now uses the injected scheduler clock. Success closes the setup registration window without aborting operation.signal. Timeout or Host closure aborts the attempt and rolls back resources. An unsettled setup cannot prevent Host closure. A late result cannot install; a late rejection is reported. Cooperative cancellation echoing the same abort reason is not reported again.

A late setup context.onDispose first attempts to release a valid resource, then throws RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL. A resource without a disposer yields INVALID_OPTION. This differs from late core.onDispose ownership. Setup failures in async use, replacement candidates, and prepared composition admissions preserve the original on PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.cause. Lazy activate preserves its original failure identity. Restart diagnostics unwrap only one PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED layer, without stripping other original cause chains.

`defineFeature(factory, dependencies?)` or `defineFeature({ install, dependencies? })` creates an opaque synchronous definition. Dependencies default to an empty map. The factory's core.featureExpose contains explicitly provided capabilities; its second argument contains declared direct dependency aliases. A factory cannot return PromiseLike, though methods of its returned object may be asynchronous. Runtime authority comes from module-owned identity stores, not the type-only __feature field.

definition.getFeature(name) requires a declared name and creates a required reference by default. getFeature(name, { optional: true }) permits undefined when its provider is absent or not activated. A disabled provider still throws PREREQUISITE_DISABLED. handle.getFeature(name) reads the instantiated output. References retain provider name literals; IPluginFeatureName and IPluginFeatureOutput extract names and outputs.

The Host validates required providers and cycles before any installer, then uses dependency order regardless of use argument order. Consumers receive the provider's exact output object, frozen per registration. Cached ordinary output objects and pure functions do not automatically gain revocation guards. Liveness checks belong to handle reads, extension callables, and protected featureExpose entries. Local Feature dependency closures also contribute cross-plugin edges. Missing, disabled, removed, and cyclic prerequisites use top-level PREREQUISITE_MISSING, PREREQUISITE_DISABLED, PREREQUISITE_REMOVED, and DEPENDENCY_CYCLE rather than an installation wrapper.

readPluginDependencies(input) returns a readonly { provider, required } list. It traverses the local closure, preserves first-provider-reference order, and lets required references win over optional duplicates. Inputs may be definitions, valid raw descriptors, or composition admissions. An admission reuses its captured snapshot without rereading getters; other inputs use standard admission once. No setup, installer, or factory runs. Native admission errors keep their exact object, runtime type, and stack.

host.config is a stable facade. Its required get path can be a plugin name, plugin.key, or plugin.[index].key, with further nesting. Unknown plugins or paths return undefined. config.update(name, recipe) requires both arguments and a synchronous partial plain-record result. Missing plugins reject with PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED. handle.config offers the same operations scoped to one plugin.

Initial configuration is copied and recursively frozen. Ordinary records, arrays, and supported primitives are accepted; function leaves retain identity, so this is not a JSON serialization domain. Date, RegExp, Map, Set, class instances, accessors, nested non-enumerable properties, symbols, dangerous proto/constructor/prototype keys, callable then, and cycles are rejected. Repeated acyclic references are not cycles. Invalid values produce INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE; cycles produce CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED, with path/reason detail. Writes to frozen snapshots follow native JavaScript behavior without a promised PluginHost code.

Updates copy and freeze patched branches while sharing untouched frozen branches. update(next, core) sees the complete candidate, while core.config.get() still reads committed configuration. Success commits it. Recipe, patch admission, update-hook, and deadline failures preserve config identity, revision, and existing extensions. Unclassified callbacks receive CALLBACK_FAILED while retaining the original object or cause. Valid PromiseLike lifecycle results are assimilated once.

Both get and update require an active Host. Ordinary get entry failures throw synchronously; failures inside update's queue reject its promise. The setup/beforeRelease synchronous guards below still apply.

sections.heading: Disablement, dependency policies, replacement, and lazy activation

blocks.text: await host.plugin.disable(name) returns { token }. await token.enable() restores that exact registration; host.plugin.enable(name) enables by name; disabled() returns a readonly name snapshot. Disablement keeps resources and scopes without disposal. Extensions, Feature outputs, and stages become unreachable, while Host configuration remains readable and updatable. A successful installation first fires onEnable; each later real transition fires its corresponding notification. Notification failures are reported without rolling back state. A dependent cannot enable while its provider remains disabled. A token preflights the full restoration group before enabling any member.

disable and unUse accept { policy?: 'reject' | 'cascade' | 'suspend'; dryRun?: boolean }, defaulting to reject and false. Reject preserves state and exposes all transitive blockers in detail.blockedBy. Cascade includes required dependents. Suspend handles the target while retaining activated dependent instances and resources. Their handles and extracted functions throw PLUGIN_SUSPENDED, and their stages stop participating. Re-enabling the same provider can restore them directly; a new provider with that name follows capability resume planning to rebind, restart, or resume. Whole-Host release remains dependent-first, including suspended registrations.

dryRun: true returns a frozen { policy, order, steps, edges } plan without ok or mutation. Real unUse success and failure both include frozen affected containing only applied steps; failure additionally includes errors. Migration: replace strict equality against the old { ok: true } shape with an ok check and affected inspection. Literal dryRun true selects the plan overload; omission/false selects execution. Branch on a broad boolean first. Retired { cascade: true } is rejected with INVALID_OPTION.

replace(name, next) requires matching names. It installs the candidate first and leaves the old implementation serving if that fails. Publication switches new runs to the new stage generation; existing runs keep old leases. Captured old functions revoke immediately, while name handles resolve the new registration. Disabled state is retained. Activated required dependents can rebind through onDependencyReplaced. Missing or failed hooks cause their required closure to drain and dispose dependent-first, then reinstall topologically, retaining runtime config and prior activation/disablement state. Old generations dispose after draining. Restart failure does not undo the new provider: failed dependents stay removed, and DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED retains an AggregateError ordered as restart failure, rebinding errors, then cleanup errors; detail.dependents lists the affected plugins. Secondary cleanup failures stay reported.

Lazy use registers without activation; extensions throw PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED. activate(name) activates required lazy providers before its own installer. Concurrent same-name calls share a promise. Eager installation activates required registered lazy providers; lazy entries used only by lazy members remain cold. Failed preflight activates nothing. Disabled activation yields PLUGIN_DISABLED. Failed activation withdraws attempted stages, extensions, and shared receipts, releases resources, and retains the cold registration/handle. Explicit retry uses a new scope and batch-bound core. Cleanup errors preserve the primary, and late physical work remains observed.

Mutations such as use, unUse, and config.update share lifecycle's FIFO queue. Defaults report waits beyond 1000 ms without a code or rejection. Only a numeric queueAdmissionTimeoutMs removes expired queued work with MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT. It does not interrupt started work or permanently disable the Host. False disables those timers and reports. Terminal dispose enters the queue without admission-timeout eviction.

Lifecycle hooks, including setup, install, Feature/expose, update, beforeRelease, disposal, enablement, and rebinding, cannot reenter Host mutation. LIFECYCLE_MUTATION is thrown by entry guards on use/unUse/replace/config.update, while asynchronous enablement entries reject their promises. Throughout an awaited setup or beforeRelease window, new mutations are rejected through the same entry-specific form. Work queued before the window remains FIFO and may reach a configured admission deadline.

Synchronous activate reentry is rejected before consulting a shared request. The runtime has no async-context tracking: after an await, same-name activate can share the active promise just like an external caller. Awaiting one's own activation self-deadlocks. A finite mutationTimeoutMs eventually rejects and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT; false can leave it pending indefinitely. Start activation outside hooks.

sections.heading: Named pipelines: types, authority, and lifecycle

blocks.text: Declare a fixed name-to-spec map in the functional entry's top-level `pipelines`, or in class constructor options. Each value is created by `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)` and independently infers its payload and mode. Names are nonempty enumerable own string keys. A structurally similar plain object is not an authentic spec. Host declarations are frozen at construction. A plugin can also declare its own group in `definePlugin({ pipelines })`; the group is created during installation, rolled back on failure, and removed after draining under the existing budget. A plugin cannot override a same-named Host pipeline; collisions fail with `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`.

rows: `'sync'`, `'async'`, `'generator'`, or `'async-generator'`; determines stages and run results.
`'single'` or `'multiple'`; uses middleware-pipeline's four-mode continuation and failure rules directly.
Allocation order, or its reverse with `'reverse'`. One plugin shares its original ordering slot across every pipeline.

blocks.text: The functional handle owner can use `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` and `.run(value, done)`. Class owners use protected `pipeline(name)`. Installing plugin and Feature cores have only `use(stage)` and `through(name)` registration authority, without run. Both named methods return a handle with idempotent `remove()`; removal affects later runs while active snapshots drain through their original lifecycle.

A plugin and its Features access Host pipelines by their original names, their own pipelines by short names, and provider pipelines as `pluginName.pipelineName` through existing Feature dependencies. Unrelated plugins cannot access another group's pipelines. `IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` remains useful for cores that use only Host declarations. When a plugin declares its own pipelines, let install infer its core so a Host-only annotation does not hide its short names. Unknown or invisible names synchronously throw `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`; the diagnostic identifies the plugin or Feature, requested name, and visible Host, own-group, and dependency scopes.

Named sync/generator runs return `TResult | undefined`; async/async-generator runs return `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`. Short-circuiting returns undefined, and each traversal that reaches the end invokes done once. Multiple mode does not return a result array: collect per-traversal results explicitly in done. In multiple mode, a stage can handle branch errors observed through next.then/await; unobserved failures still reject the runner, with several originals retained in start order under `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED`. Generators receive suffix failures through throw at yield; sync processes all registered values before aggregating failures.

Pipeline publication belongs to the same Host commit. Each pipeline reuses its compiled snapshot within a visible stage revision; reverse ordering is also compiled once. Empty lanes call the terminal directly without a snapshot or lease. Nonempty lanes reuse the same registration, ordering, and quiescence/lease owners. Rollback, unUse, replace, disablement, and suspension affect all of a plugin's pipelines in one commit. Existing runs retain their original snapshots and generation leases distinguished by pipeline; drain joins that actual work under the existing lifecycle budgets. Owner registration on any pipeline while another is executing throws `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`.

Without Host declarations, its named axis defaults to `Record<never, never>`; known plugin definitions still infer their qualified names. If neither the Host nor any plugin declares a named group, no extra named runner, lane, or lease key is allocated. Existing TValue, pipeline.mode, use*Pipeline, runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync, and pipelineMode still address only the default pipeline; old explicit generic calls remain valid. Its private symbol occupies no string name. When explicitly supplying defineHost generics together with named declarations, pass `typeof pipelines` as the fifth parameter. Omitting that axis keeps it empty, so pipeline(name) accepts only never.

Invalid maps, names, specs, and order fail synchronously during construction as a native TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`, without returning a handle. Invalid mode retains `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`. Invalid next uses outer `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` with middleware-pipeline's TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` on cause. A spec configuration getter failure also keeps its original cause under `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`.

`core.pipeline('y').through('z')` enters z at that position in y. The terminal of z is the remaining suffix and original terminal of y. The target can transform the same payload type, short-circuit, or handle the suffix result after an async stage's `await next(value)`. Its own order still applies.

Payload types and modes must match. Different modes fail with `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`; a multiple target with a non-multiple source, or a registration that creates a cycle, fails with `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`. Cycles are checked at registration. An empty target directly calls the source next without a target snapshot or lease. Through returns a registration handle with idempotent `remove()`, owned by its registering plugin and withdrawn on removal. `use` still accepts only a stage, never a string or pipeline object; Host owners retain use/run.

The following four use*Pipeline methods return this on the Host and the core on a plugin; named use/through return registration handles. Unsupported lifts synchronously throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH with the upstream middleware-pipeline TypeError / INVALID_OPTION on cause.

For the default pipeline, class owners invoke protected runPipeline(value, done) from a domain entry; functional handles expose it directly. Both value and done are required. Sync next records a value and starts downstream after the current stage returns. Async next starts downstream immediately; awaiting it supports after-downstream logic. Omitting next is normal short-circuiting: done is skipped while the run can complete successfully. Duplicate next under the default single policy produces PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE; late next is ignored and reported as PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE.

With the default single policy, generator modes drain the current stage before passing its ordinary return value onward. Implicit undefined or GENERATOR_HALT stops the chain. GENERATOR_CONTINUE selects the last yield, or the input if nothing yielded. GENERATOR_UNDEFINED forwards an actual undefined payload only when its type permits it. Async-generator awaits serially; it provides neither streaming fan-out nor onion execution. Import modes, stage types, and these unique symbols directly from middleware-pipeline, and install that dependency directly when importing it.
When returned from a stage, these three symbols control traversal rather than represent business data.

This example uppercases the input `migaia`, then adds square brackets. The first stage returns `GENERATOR_CONTINUE` to pass its last yielded value to the second stage; the second returns the final string directly.
It prints `[MIGAIA]`: the second stage receives `MIGAIA`, and the completion callback receives the bracketed result. Intermediate yields do not invoke downstream stages individually.

Registering stages while any nested run remains active throws PIPELINE_EXECUTING. A run captures its admitted stages. Host stages and plugin slots follow first-allocation order; disabling, restoring, and replacing retain positions. New runs do not acquire revoked generations; old runs retain their leases until completion or cooperative exit.

All stage modes receive context last; generators receive it second. context.signal is the Host lifecycle signal and aborts when disposal starts. A stage must use it to cancel its own I/O. At stage entry, return, or next dispatch, the runner can stop with HOST_DISPOSING or HOST_DISPOSED; it cannot preempt arbitrary promises. A signal reason and later admission error may have matching semantic identity without being the same object. Ordinary failure wins over simultaneous cancellation; one ordinary failure preserves its object. Async stage/downstream dual failures use AggregateError / PIPELINE_FAILED with [stageError, downstreamError]. Serial async-generator failures from factory, body, or done have no equivalent dual-frame aggregation.

Before an installed registration is released, beforeRelease(context) runs at most once. During ordinary removal its publication still serves existing calls. The context signal belongs to that registration; deadlineAt and remainingMs() use the Host clock and disposeStepTimeoutMs. Disablement, suspension, and cold lazy registration alone do not trigger it. Failure or timeout is collected without rolling removal back. Migration: a nonfunction beforeRelease formerly used as metadata now fails as TypeError / INVALID_OPTION.

Removal withdraws new registration/stage admission, drains the relevant leases, runs the plugin disposer, then releases registered resources in reverse order. Ordinary unUse/dispose uses per-step disposeStepTimeoutMs. Reaching it records DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT and continues without cancelling an active promise. A disposer awaiting the host.dispose that invoked it creates self-waiting; a finite step budget allows logical closure to proceed, while false waits indefinitely.

unUse returns { ok: true, affected } or { ok: false, errors, affected }. Drain timeout records PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT and continues bounded cleanup. Default core dispose shares one promise across repeated calls and synchronous reentry. It returns logicalTerminal, cleanupErrors, cleanupComplete, and possibly physicalCompletion without reopening the Host on cleanup failure. Custom defineHost options.dispose middleware can throw or reject: that failure is classified and rejects the same memoized promise. Core structured cleanup does not guarantee that arbitrary middleware cannot reject.

cleanupComplete false does not mean resources have been released. cleanupErrors is a current snapshot; physicalCompletion carries later errors and may itself have a continuation. To obtain the complete final result, use lifecycle mergeCleanupResults([result]) and install lifecycle directly when importing it. Finite waits do not terminate running leases/disposers; late failures remain observed.

Cleanup functions run directly. Resource objects prefer asynchronous disposal, then synchronous disposal. A plugin's dispose hook takes precedence over symbol cleanup. asyncDisposeKey uses native Symbol.asyncDispose when available, otherwise the module fallback. Synchronous resources can use native Symbol.dispose or ordinary functions, without mandatory polyfills.

isManagedHost(value) recognizes Hosts created by this physical module instance. openComposition(host) accepts those identities, including class and functional Hosts; a lookalike or another installed module copy is not sufficient. The identity writer is private, and defineHost accepts no receiver alias.

revision is the Host's committed modification version, not a count of attempted operations. A composition owner reads revision/getCurrentSnapshot(), captures definitions with createPluginAdmission, reserves opaque positions with createDataOrderSlot(name), then calls prepareAdmissions([{ admission, slot }]). Setup may execute, but candidate extensions, config, Features, and stages remain unpublished. commitPreparedAdmissions is synchronous without user code and rejects stale revisions. discardPreparedAdmissions rolls temporary resources back once. Returned registration tokens identify exact installations rather than whichever plugin currently has a name.

Calling createDataOrderSlot reserves its order immediately. Disablement, recovery, and replacement reuse it. Retire it only when a definition is permanently removed or the session ends. prepareUnUseBatch accepts exact tokens in the owner's cleanup order. commitPreparedUnUseBatch(prepared, { beforeCleanup? }) first commits logical revocation, then waits for the fence and generation-specific pipeline leases. beforeCleanup is optional without a default promise; when supplied it completes before cleanup.

Managed cleanup uses execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs (default 5000). A number is shared across the batch's leases and cleanup steps; exhaustion continues later steps even if ordinary disposeStepTimeoutMs is false. Explicit pipelineDrainTimeoutMs false instead waits for actual completion step by step, bypassing ordinary limits. The budget does not revoke running work. Wait for every physicalCompletion continuation to finish before treating physical release as complete, or let the outer realm owner terminate its actual execution environment.

createView(token) exposes only that exact registration's extensions, without Host, config, shared, or mutation capability. Repeated views keep function references and concrete Host receivers. Token views remain valid during disablement; complete Host views reject then and recover their original function references on enablement. Removal revokes both. Foreign or revoked tokens fail closed. Migration: the old root createRegistrationView and IPluginRegistrationReceipt were removed; use composition createView/IRegistrationToken.

inspectFeatures(roots) from composition reads trusted Feature topology without executing factories. Adapter-only getPluginRuntimeIntegration(core) accepts a canonical module core and connects declared shared outlets, Features, and registration lifetimes. It is not an admission bypass for ordinary plugins. Only canonical same-family contributions share a slot; ordinary extensions and other families cannot occupy it. A new shared getter publication on a nonextensible Host preserves native TypeError with PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED and leaves no failed family behind. Ordinary handle extensions retain their existing nonextensible-Host contract.

PluginHostError extends Error with readonly source, code, and optional detail. Its source is plugin.host; cause/errors retain original failures. Mutable native callback errors receive identity in place; immutable or non-Error values remain on cause. Complete foreign identities retain their owner. INVALID_OPTION keeps TypeError; configuration-domain and cycle failures are PluginHostError. Do not classify all failures by one class or parse diagnostic text.

Rollback failures do not replace installation failures. PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail includes failedName and rollbackErrors in release order. Async use publishes a completed frozen detail; sync useSync publishes a frozen snapshot with detail.completion for final frozen identities. Await completion before translating errors that need all secondary failures. PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED is an additional diagnostic.

diagnostic's third argument retains the original contained failure. Reporter failures cannot alter Host control flow: onDiagnosticFailure receives them, then globalThis.reportError is used if available when that outlet is missing or also fails. Provide onDiagnosticFailure explicitly when Node observation is needed. PluginHostStatus is active/closing/disposed; PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle is idle/install/dispose. ERROR_TEXT is the named root export of stable English texts. MiddlewarePipelineMode and Violation belong to middleware-pipeline.

PluginHostDisposalNodeKind distinguishes Host errors, aggregates, and disposer wrappers. readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error) reads only provenance registered by this physical module instance. Unknown errors and another module copy return undefined rather than structural guesses. This supports diagnostics, not a replacement for source/code/cause handling.
